title: Exact native gauges: 698 → 674 scalar allowance, with a zero-scratch option
body:
Four authenticated native cleanup blocks cost 766 scalar allowance per orientation in main. The rank-factor compiler in #4494 reduces that to 698. This package adds an exact power-of-two gauge optimizer: it reaches **686 with no additional owned fields**, or **674 with one reusable owned field** by selecting the cheaper of gauges and the inherited rank-one sum macro. Both inverse-transpose orientations are checked, including every scale/unscale and owned-field clear.

The new reusable result is a sufficient exact replacement for any disjoint common-chart dyadic block, with a feasible signed circulation certifying the optimum within the declared gauge family. This is classical min-cost-flow duality specialized to the native scalar price; no unrestricted circuit-optimality claim. The rank-one alternative and source-window fixtures are credited to #4489/#4494. See `research/exact-unit-gauges/ATTRIBUTION.md` for upstream compiler contributors and MathProof discovery precedents.

Validation: source-byte pins and actual contiguous native window extraction; 320 exact symbolic-column checks across both modes/orientations; 100 deterministic random cases; 10 bounded exhaustive cross-checks; rejection controls for altered flows, missing restoration/clears, illegal scalars and shifted selectors. Registered replay, isolated optimized replay, committed-byte checks and a Git-free exported replay pass. Standard-library Python only; tested on Windows, Linux execution not available.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/exact-unit-gauges/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/exact-unit-gauges
```

Scoped partial contribution, **no new κ**, no new recursive jobs, no productive-temporary credit and no selected-frontier change. Full rebuilt stock/norm/coefficient and multiplication-bound replay remains necessary before using the savings in a global bound. Canonical main was refreshed at the submission checkpoint and remained `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db`. Recent visible PRs through #4495 were checked; cached overlap coverage is incomplete, with remote cache/API failures recorded explicitly. No novelty claim follows from that incomplete coverage.

Prepared for Dugongue with substantial OpenAI assistance; Apache-2.0. The package contains the proof, executable programs, source pins, certificates and open next questions.
